ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Heavy riffs with melodic hooks fit my recent listening; I would try this today.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The guitar-driven sound appeals, but other albums here are closer to my current mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: The End of Heartache; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The mix of aggression and melody fits my interest in In Flames and Soilwork; I would choose this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ascendancy       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its energetic riffs appeal to the same mood as Advance And Vanquish; I would give it a listen.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Sickness; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Having recently explored Ten Thousand Fists, I would like to hear more from Disturbed.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, abrasive sound is less appealing than the melodic heaviness I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The War Within; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The riff-heavy intensity fits, but I would save it for another session.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mezmerize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy, unpredictable songs interest me, but they are not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Christ Illusion; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for more melody and less relentless aggression this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Live In Texas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in discovering studio albums than listening to a live set right now.
